procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Published personal instructions: file/serve motion, email assistant copying parties with motion, case number and requested duration; coordinate and obtain office confirmation before notice. Central time; no piggybacking without written approval.
procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Copy all parties/counsel and include county/case number in subject. Profile/directory name Isaacs; PDF names Taylor with a different mailbox, retained as a source discrepancy.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: Motion must be filed/served before scheduling; provide office copy with hearing request. Detailed trial-setting requirements not abstracted.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Circulate proposed orders to all parties, then e-file with explanatory cover letter stating objections. Stipulated orders require actual consent; silence is not approval.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: For remote-hearing exhibits, request a OneDrive folder from assistant at least three days before hearing. No broader courtesy-copy rule established in reviewed personal source.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Published Zoom meeting5865139458; invitation the week before scheduled Zoom hearing. Telephone alternative when video unavailable, with source notary requirement; video preferred for testimony. Instructions do not establish blanket permission for every hearing to be remote.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Coordinate hearing dates and circulate orders. No separate general motion-conferral rule identified in this personal document.

facts.review_scope: Official profile and directory comparison; four-page personal procedure PDF reviewed for recurring scheduling, submissions, orders, communications and remote channels. Civil trial-setting paragraph and linked family trial/Calhoun case-management documents retained as source/link only, not generalized to Jackson.
